## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 While modern secondary literature in the dossier does not provide an independent thematic analysis of this discourse, I. B. Horner notes that the *Udāna* commentary (*Paramatthadīpanī* / UdA 205) defines the craft of writing (*lekhā-sippa*) as inscribing syllables in various ways in connection with discussions of worldly crafts not intended for monks [Horner]. Other reference passages in the dossier focus on the generic noun *sippa* ("craft", "art") as an occupational category in early Buddhist social stratification and education rather than examining this sutta directly [Horner].
